shops.name: Starter Shop
shops.title: Starter Shop
shops.description: The first shop you'll encounter. A cozy wooden building surrounded by trees and bushes, offering the essential tools and gear for new beekeepers. Carries 5 tools, 4 bags, and 6 gear pieces purchasable with Honey.
shops.about: The Shop is a wooden building located near Black Bear. It has one door at the front and two large windows. It is surrounded by trees and bushes, giving it a cozy and welcoming look. The outside has a few wall lights that keep the area bright. Inside you can find 5 tools, 4 bags, and 1 of each type of gear.

shops.about: The Advanced Shop is a wooden building located in the 10 Bee Zone, near the Spider Field. It has one door at the front and two large windows. Wall lights on the outside keep the area lit despite the darker atmosphere of the zone. Inside, you can find mid-tier equipment suited for more experienced beekeepers.
